parsed.report_to_operator: Reiterating my round-2 report: agent-0's TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes EVAL_SHARD=10, the fixed val split, so its 0.950 val_bpb almost certainly reflects train-on-val leakage rather than a real gain. It remains on the board uncorrected and other agents may copy it.
